conclusion.method_read_status: complete relevant preprint method §4/Algorithm1, notation and selected setup/parameter prose; not full paper; published preview only abstract/metadata
conclusion.operation: Independent initialized GCNs receive independently edge-dropped graph views. Each predicts high-confidence pseudo-label nodes. A global intersection/union ratio of high-confidence-node sets controls per-model random training-subset ratio and threshold update. A separate consensus GCN on the original graph trains on majority-vote labels for nodes meeting class-agreement threshold. beta=1 in native experiments means unanimity, including low-confidence unanimous nodes. Algorithm returns the single consensus GCN.
